 Description
 ***OPEN HOUSE Saturday 31 October 12noon*** 
A bright and well-proportioned brand newly refurbished one-bedroom apartment set on a quiet residential street in Archway, offering balanced living space and excellent access to green open spaces and transport links. Positioned within Ritchie House, the property features a generous reception room, separate kitchen, comfortable double bedroom, and a well-appointed bathroom, all arranged with a natural sense of flow and functionality.
The apartment is ideally located moments from Elthorne Park and within easy reach of Whittington Park, Waterlow Park, and Hampstead Heath, while a growing selection of cafés, restaurants, and pubs are nearby on Junction Road. Excellent connectivity is provided by Crouch Hill Station and Archway Station, alongside multiple bus routes on the doorstep.
An ideal location for, offering a combination of immediate liveability and long-term growth potential in one of North London’s most up-and-coming neighbourhoods.
A well-proportioned one-bedroom apartment set within a quiet residential position on Hazellville Road, offering bright, balanced living space and immediate access to some of North London’s most celebrated green spaces and transport connections.
Positioned within Ritchie House, the apartment is arranged to provide a natural sense of flow between living, resting, and practical areas. The principal reception room is generously sized, with ample space for both seating and dining, and is illuminated by large windows that draw in consistent natural light throughout the day. The adjoining kitchen is neatly configured, offering a practical layout with clean lines and good storage, suited to both everyday use and low-maintenance living.
The bedroom is comfortably proportioned and designed as a calm, private retreat, with space for wardrobes and additional furnishings. A well-appointed bathroom completes the accommodation, finished in a neutral palette that reinforces the apartment’s understated, functional aesthetic.
The setting is a defining feature. Hazellville Road sits within easy reach of Elthorne Park, home to the Philip Noel-Baker Peace Garden, while Whittington Park lies nearby with its outdoor gym, sports pitches, playground, and community café. Waterlow Park, with its elevated views across central London, is also close at hand, alongside the open expanses of Hampstead Heath and Highgate Woods.
The surrounding neighbourhood continues to evolve, with a growing collection of independent cafés, restaurants, and pubs centred around Junction Road. Well-regarded local establishments such as St John's Tavern, Archway Tavern, and Oak & Pastor contribute to a lively yet relaxed local character.
Cultural and leisure amenities are equally accessible, including Jacksons Lane, a renowned arts space set within a converted church, and Archway Leisure Centre, offering a full range of fitness and swimming facilities.
Connectivity is excellent. Crouch Hill Station is approximately a 10-minute walk away, providing Overground services, while Archway Station is around 13 minutes on foot, offering direct access to King’s Cross in approximately 10 minutes and Bank in around 18 minutes. Bus routes run directly from Hazellville Road, further enhancing accessibility.
Archway itself is increasingly recognised as one of North London’s key growth areas, benefiting from ongoing regeneration and public realm improvements. It offers a compelling alternative to neighbouring Highgate and Dartmouth Park, combining relative affordability with access to the same green spaces, amenities, and transport links.

 A beautifully refurbished onebedroom flat combining period character with modern living, moments from Angel.
Set above one of Islington’s most vibrant streets, this light-filled flat has been refurbished to a high standard throughout. It has warm oak-effect flooring, crisp white walls and a layout of separate rooms that gives it a real sense of space.
The reception room is the heart of the home and a real showpiece. It is generously proportioned and well lit by two tall sash windows. It keeps its original character, with a cast iron arched fireplace set within a marble surround, an ornate ceiling rose and detailed cornicing. Soft wall uplighters add warmth in the evenings, and the room easily fits both a lounge and a dining area.
The separate kitchen is bright and stylish. It is finished in glossy grey cabinetry with white stone-effect worktops and a striking blue-green brick-tile splashback. A four-ring gas hob, built-in oven, fridge and washing machine are all included. A sash window above the sink looks out across classic London brickwork.
The double bedroom is a calm, airy retreat. It comes with a large three-door wardrobe with a full-length mirror, a bedside chest and a blackout blind, and it shares the same elegant cornicing as the rest of the flat.
The contemporary shower room is fully tiled in soft grey stone-effect tiles. It has a curved glass shower enclosure with a rainfall shower head, a sleek vanity basin, a mirror cabinet, a heated towel rail and recessed lighting.
Location: You’re right in the heart of Angel. The famous Chapel Market is on your doorstep, offering fresh produce, street food, cafés and restaurants. Upper Street’s bars, shops and theatres are a short stroll away, and Angel Underground station (Northern line) is just minutes on foot. King’s Cross St Pancras is close by for national and international travel.

 London 
 Bright top-floor 1-bed flat with private balcony – King’s Cross / Barnsbury, N1 
 A bright, peaceful one-bedroom flat on the top floor of a quiet low-rise block, tucked between King's Cross and Barnsbury and just a short walk from the ever-popular Granary Square and Coal Drops Yard.
 The heart of the home is a generous living and dining room that runs the full depth of the flat. Large windows look straight out over Bingfield Park, so you have green views all day. A glazed door leads onto your own private balcony, the perfect spot for a morning coffee or a glass of wine on a summer evening. The room comes furnished with a corner sofa bed, coffee table and dining table, and there's space to work from home comfortably.
 The separate kitchen is fully fitted with lots of cupboard space and all the appliances you need. The double bedroom is quiet and restful, with a fitted wardrobe and a window onto the balcony. The bathroom has a full-size bath with shower. Two cupboards in the hallway keep coats, cases and the hoover out of sight.
 ✨ Highlights 
 🌿 Park views and lots of natural light
 🌤 Private balcony with glass balustrade
 🛗 Top floor with lift access
 🍳 Fitted kitchen with fridge-freezer, microwave, dishwasher and washing machine
 🔥 Heating and hot water included in the rent, double glazing throughout
 🚆 About 6 minutes' walk to Caledonian Road & Barnsbury Overground and 12 minutes to King's Cross St Pancras
 You'll love the location. Granary Square and Coal Drops Yard, with their canal-side restaurants, bars, shops and fountains, are an easy stroll along the Regent's Canal towpath. For everyday coffee and groceries, Caledonian Road is just around the corner, while the buzz of Upper Street is within easy reach. King's Cross St Pancras puts six Tube lines, Eurostar and national rail on your doorstep, and Caledonian Road (Piccadilly line) is also around 12 minutes away.
 Furnished and available from December, 7. Ideal for a professional single person or couple. EPC rating D.
 Get in touch to arrange a viewing. We'd love to show you around.

 £1,950 pcm | Unfurnished
 We’re pleased to present this bright, well-presented one-bedroom apartment in the sought-after Ashburton Triangle development, right beside the Emirates Stadium in Highbury.
 The spacious open-plan reception room is filled with natural light, thanks to floor-to-ceiling glazed doors leading out to a private balcony with views over the stadium. Warm wooden flooring runs throughout the living area, creating a welcoming space that works equally well for relaxing and entertaining.
 The kitchen is set off the reception room in its own recess. It’s fitted with ample wall and base units, an integrated oven and hob, an extractor hood, and space for a washing machine.
 The double bedroom is a comfortable, peaceful retreat, with a large window and a fitted mirrored sliding wardrobe providing plenty of storage.
 The building benefits from a concierge service. Its location is excellent: just moments from Arsenal Underground station (Piccadilly line) and Drayton Park station, with Highbury & Islington, Holloway Road and Finsbury Park all close by. The area offers a great selection of shops, cafés, restaurants and green spaces, including Highbury Fields.
 Offered unfurnished, this apartment is ideal for a professional or couple looking for a stylish, well-connected home in North London.

 One double bedroom with fitted mirrored wardrobe
 Bright open-plan reception room with wooden flooring
 Private balcony with stadium views

 Concierge

 Description
 A particularly well-proportioned two-bedroom apartment to rent on Heddington Grove, quietly positioned within a residential development in Holloway while remaining exceptionally well connected to Caledonian Road, Barnsbury, King's Cross and central Islington.
Extending to approximately 582 sq ft / 54 sq m, the property offers noticeably more usable accommodation than many two-bedroom apartments within this price bracket, with a sensible layout that provides clearly defined living, sleeping and kitchen areas without compromising on room proportions.
The apartment is presented in a clean, modern and well-maintained condition, with the accommodation having benefited from a recently refurbished kitchen and bathroom.
The separate kitchen has been finished in a contemporary style, providing excellent storage and worktop space while keeping the cooking area away from the main reception room.
The reception room is generously proportioned and provides ample space for both living and dining furniture, making the apartment equally suitable for entertaining, relaxing or incorporating a home-working area.
There are two well-proportioned bedrooms, including a particularly generous principal double bedroom, with useful built-in storage helping to maximise the available space.
The second bedroom is also a genuine usable room, making the property suitable for a professional couple wanting additional space, two professional sharers or someone looking for a proper home office or guest bedroom.
The bathroom has also been recently refurbished, continuing the neutral contemporary finish seen throughout the apartment and giving the property a particularly move-in-ready feel.
One of the major attractions is the location. Heddington Grove offers a quieter residential setting while placing tenants within immediate reach of some of North London's most popular and best-connected neighbourhoods.
Caledonian Road Underground station provides access to the Piccadilly line, while Caledonian Road & Barnsbury Overground station is also close by. King's Cross St Pancras is within easy reach, providing Underground, national rail and international connections.
For lifestyle, residents are exceptionally well positioned between Barnsbury, Upper Street, King's Cross and Coal Drops Yard.
Upper Street provides an extensive selection of restaurants, cafés, bars, boutiques and everyday amenities, while Granary Square and Coal Drops Yard offer further dining, shopping and waterside spaces around the Regent's Canal.

A very bright and spacious one double bedroom split level flat located in this impressive historical grade two listed building in a former royal mail sorting office.

 One bedroom apartment in the heart of Stroud Green

 Double bedroom with arch-headed sash window

 Finsbury Park itself is around 0.3 miles away, with its boating lake, tennis courts and stunning views.

 Un Furnished
 Set above the independent delis, cafes and gift shops of Stroud Green Road, this bright one bedroom flat puts you right at the heart of one of North London’s best-loved high streets. Freshly decorated throughout and ready to move straight into, it’s a calm, light-filled home with Finsbury Park Station only a few minutes’ walk from the front door.
 Arriving on the second floor, the front door opens directly into a generous open-plan reception room and kitchen that stretches nearly 26ft from front to back. Crisp white walls and warm oak-toned wood-effect flooring run throughout, while recessed spotlights keep everything bright long after the daylight has gone. A painted white column marks a natural divide between living and cooking, lending the room a relaxed, loft-like feel and making it easy to zone. Picture a sofa and a reading lamp by the arch-headed sash window at the front, with a small dining table set nearer the kitchen for suppers and Sunday papers.
 The kitchen sits at the rear, where a wide window over the sink frames a leafy green outlook, making even the washing up a pleasure. Clean white cabinetry with brushed bar handles is paired with speckled granite-effect worktops and white tiled splashbacks. A freestanding gas cooker with four-ring hob, an Indesit washing machine and an under-counter Frigidaire fridge are all provided, with a separate full-height fridge freezer standing in the living space beyond.
 The bedroom is a well-proportioned double at over 12ft long, with plenty of room for a double bed and wardrobe. Like the reception, it looks out over Stroud Green Road through a tall sash window with a pretty arched head, echoing the arches across the building’s front and adding a lovely touch of period character. Completing the flat, the shower room has a walk-in shower enclosure with sliding glass door and handheld shower on a riser rail, alongside a WC, pedestal basin and oval mirror. A frosted window brings in natural light and fresh air.
 Fresh, neutral and easy to settle into, this is a home that will happily take on your own rugs, plants and pictures. It would suit a professional single or couple looking for a quick commute without giving up the buzz of a proper neighbourhood high street.
 The Neighbourhood: Stroud Green 
 Everything you need is on your doorstep here. Common Ground, just a few doors along, is a local favourite for Dark Arts coffee, sandwiches and pastries, with a garden that fills up quickly on sunny days. Round the corner on Perth Road, The Faltering Fullback is a much-loved pub with a nationally recognised heritage interior, a Thai kitchen at the back and a flower-filled garden spread over several levels of decking. Rowans Tenpin Bowl at the bottom of the road adds a dose of old-school fun for late nights out.
 Finsbury Park itself is a short stroll away, with its boating lake, tennis courts and busy calendar of weekend events. Finsbury Park Station is around 0.2 miles from the flat, served by the Victoria and Piccadilly lines alongside Great Northern and Thameslink trains to King’s Cross, Moorgate and beyond. Insider tip: Bon Matin beside the station is the perfect stop for a pastry on the way to work - we’d highly recommend the almond croissant. You can also use your laptop in there, so it’s a great spot to get out of the house, do a little work and try one of their amazing sweet or savoury patisserie items.

 A particularly well-proportioned two-bedroom apartment to rent on Heddington Grove, quietly positioned within a residential development in Holloway while remaining exceptionally well connected to Caledonian Road, Barnsbury, King's Cross and central Islington.
Extending to approximately 582 sq ft / 54 sq m, the property offers noticeably more usable accommodation than many two-bedroom apartments within this price bracket, with a sensible layout that provides clearly defined living, sleeping and kitchen areas without compromising on room proportions.
The apartment is presented in a clean, modern and well-maintained condition, with the accommodation having benefited from a recently refurbished kitchen and bathroom.
The separate kitchen has been finished in a contemporary style, providing excellent storage and worktop space while keeping the cooking area away from the main reception room.
The reception room is generously proportioned and provides ample space for both living and dining furniture, making the apartment equally suitable for entertaining, relaxing or incorporating a home-working area.
There are two well-proportioned bedrooms, including a particularly generous principal double bedroom, with useful built-in storage helping to maximise the available space.
The second bedroom is also a genuine usable room, making the property suitable for a professional couple wanting additional space, two professional sharers or someone looking for a proper home office or guest bedroom.
The bathroom has also been recently refurbished, continuing the neutral contemporary finish seen throughout the apartment and giving the property a particularly move-in-ready feel.
One of the major attractions is the location. Heddington Grove offers a quieter residential setting while placing tenants within immediate reach of some of North London's most popular and best-connected neighbourhoods.
Caledonian Road Underground station provides access to the Piccadilly line, while Caledonian Road & Barnsbury Overground station is also close by. King's Cross St Pancras is within easy reach, providing Underground, national rail and international connections.
For lifestyle, residents are exceptionally well positioned between Barnsbury, Upper Street, King's Cross and Coal Drops Yard.
Upper Street provides an extensive selection of restaurants, cafés, bars, boutiques and everyday amenities, while Granary Square and Coal Drops Yard offer further dining, shopping and waterside spaces around the Regent's Canal.

 2 bedrooms 
 2 bathrooms 
 4 tenants max. 
 London 
 Scroll through the photos to see the video of this beautiful boat
Have you considered being a liveaboard boater?
Fancy exploring the canals of London, moving through and staying for periods in super central places like Kings Cross' Granary Square, Islington nr Angel station, Broadway Market, Victoria Park?
Escape the Rat Race Have been supporting long term boat escapes for nearly 20 years, this is an EtRR Boat
Viewings are available now.
 Check out the video of the inside of one of our other ETRR boats to give you a good idea of the style and fit-out. If you're viewing this advert on a mobile, just drop us a message and we'll send the video over. If you're viewing on a computer, you should see a video tab above the images.
 We'd also really recommend coming to view this beautiful vessel in person if you like what you see. Videos and photos are useful, but nothing beats seeing the boat in the flesh, getting a feel for the space and deciding whether it's right for you.
The boat is a widebeam (3 metres x 20 metres) and has a double bedroom, beautiful kitchen and dining area and separate living room. It is very comfortable living for singles or couples. the boat contains:
Coal burning stove
Central heating radiators
Double room
Double bed
Outdoor seating area
Latest security - steal stern doors, enfield locks etc
Bathroom with hot and cold running water and toilet
Mains electricity
Lots of storage
Location
The boat moves around London and will mainly be within zones 1, 2 and 3 however due to the nature of the license the boat has to move every 2 weeks and must span a specified minimum distance over a year and therefore is sometimes further afield. We will follow a semi flexible cruising calendar which, depending on there being space in certain locations, will allow you to know where you'll be on the cruise at certain times.
This is a minimum 6 month contract (can be extended at the end of the period), references and credit check required.
The administration and contracting of the vessel will be done through Escape the Rat Race. This is the only legitimate way to live on a fully insured and licensed boat that is continuously cruising through Canal and River Trust waters.
FAQ
Is this advert for a whole boat?
Yes
Do you offer shared boat options?
Yes we do. Please see other adverts posted on this platform or message us.
 W ould like a narrowboat 
Send us a message on this platform we have narrowboats and can help - make it clear in the message you are interested in a narrowboat.
Can you offer less than 6 months contract?
 A fraid we cant, there is a terrific investment of time and energy in getting someone on a boat, instructing them on handling it, run through safety demonstrations, giving adhoc advice, registering for insurance, responding to new occupant queries etc. Anything less than 6 months is not economical for EtRR, the average stay is 9 months.
Can you offer a short stay of 1-10 days?
No. You need a hotel boat for this. It is not something we offer. Google Canalboat hotel
Are the boats safe?
yes @ EtRR we maintain that the ongoing health and safety of occupants is the single highest priority, we carry out regular checks on all vessels, all are correctly fitted with safety alarms, all have the correct certification and all checked for defects, wear + tear and maintenance on every site visit (on average 1 visit which includes safety check per boat per month). This makes them amongst the safest cruising boats on the canal.

 We are pleased to offer this one-bedroom, one-bathroom flat in a well-connected location close to Newington Green, Canonbury, Dalston and Highbury.
 The property is available from 1 November 2026 and can be offered furnished or unfurnished, depending on the tenant’s preference.
 Newington Green’s shops, cafés and restaurants are close by, with Dalston’s restaurants, bars and entertainment venues within walking distance. Highbury and Islington’s shops and amenities are also within easy reach.
 The flat benefits from convenient transport links:
 Canonbury station: approximately 5–10 minutes’ walk, with London Overground services on the Mildmay and Windrush lines.
 Dalston Kingsland and Dalston Junction stations: approximately 15–20 minutes’ walk, providing further Overground connections.
 Highbury & Islington station: approximately 15–20 minutes’ walk, offering the Victoria line, London Overground and National Rail services.
 Nearby buses: the 73 provides direct connections to Angel, King’s Cross and the West End; the 341 serves Angel, Farringdon and Waterloo; and the 30 connects with Highbury Corner and Dalston Junction.
 Walking times are approximate and depend on the route and walking pace.
 Viewing is highly recommended. Contact us through OpenRent for more information or to arrange a viewing.

 A high-spec one-bedroom apartment on the Islington and Camden border, brand new throughout and sharing its floor with only one other apartment. With a private hallway entrance and a separate kitchen and dining area, it's a quiet, comfortable home for a professional or a couple.
The space
The apartment is on the second floor and measures around 40 sq m. The large bedroom has a double bed and ample storage, and there's a private en-suite shower room with high-spec finishes. The good-sized kitchen is fully equipped for everyday cooking, with a separate dining and living area. The building is a recently refurbished development of 14 apartments with secure keycode entry, a lift, a ground-floor communal workspace and front and rear communal patios.
What's included
- High-speed internet throughout the building and a TV
- Private hallway entrance
- Communal workspace
- Lift
- Washing machine
- Fully equipped kitchen
- Iron and hair dryer
- Bed linen and towels
- Heating
- All bills included in the rent
The area and transport
The building sits on a quiet residential street on the border of Islington and Camden, and the local high street, with plenty of shops and cafés, is about 5 minutes' walk away. Tufnell Park Underground station is around 10 minutes on foot, with Kentish Town and Caledonian Road stations 15 to 20 minutes' walk. Leicester Square can be reached in under 30 minutes, while King's Cross and Camden Market are about 20 minutes by bus. Paid parking nearby can be booked through YourParkingSpace.
Short let only: minimum stay 1 month, maximum stay 6 months. Fully furnished, all bills included. Deposit £500. Available from 1 November 2026.

 Stylish ground-floor flat with large, sunny garden in the heart of Dalston.  
 The flat embraces the available space and natural light, with an open-plan kitchen, dining and living area that looks out on and accesses the low maintenance garden. 
 The two-bedroom property is on a quiet residential street, and set in a Victorian terrace block and period conversion. 
 It has its own private entrance, and multiple internal and external storage areas. 
 Available to move in from 7 November 2026 . 
 The flat is close to the many popular high street shops, markets, cafes and restaurants around Dalston, Newington Green, Stoke Newington, Canonbury, London Fields, Broadway Market, Angel, and other parts of Islington and Hackney. 
 Dalston Kingsland and Dalston Junction stations are within walking distance. 
 Key Features:  
 - Two bedrooms (double bedroom: 4 x 2.7m of floor space, plus built-in double wardrobe and separate large storage cupboard; single bedroom: 3.2 x 2.5m) 
 - Open-plan kitchen / dining / living area 
 - Garden is large, south-facing and sunny 
 - One bathroom  
 - Excellent local amenities: short walk to cafes, restaurants, shops, daily market and supermarkets 
- Great transport links: close to Dalston Kingsland and Dalston Junction stations, many bus stops nearby  
 Dimensions: 
 - Internal area: 57 sq m / 613 sq ft approx 
 - Garden: 65 sq m / 700 sq ft approx 
 - External storage area: 5 sq m / 54 sq ft approx 
 Transport: 
 Mildmay Road is close to both Dalston Kingsland and Dalston Junction stations, as well as the many buses that stop along Kingsland Road, Stoke Newington High Street and/or near Newington Green. 
This means the East London / Overground lines, Highbury & Islington station, Canary Wharf, Liverpool Street, the City and central London are all quick and easy to get to.

 A bright and charming two double bedroom apartment set within a handsome period conversion, moments from Finsbury Park station and local cafes, restaurants and shops.

A stylish and well presented one bedroom apartment set within a modern development on Queensbridge Road, E8. Perfectly positioned between Broadway Market, London Fields, Dalston and Columbia Road, this home offers the very best of East London living right on your doorstep.

Broadway Market, with its mix of independent cafés, restaurants and Saturday market stalls, is just a short stroll away, while London Fields offers green space and the popular lido. Transport connections are excellent, with London Fields, Haggerston and Dalston Junction Overground stations all within walking distance, providing fast and convenient links into the City and Canary Wharf.
This apartment is an ideal choice for a professional couple or single occupant looking for a contemporary home with outside space in one of East Londons most desirable locations.

 A beautifully refurbished onebedroom flat combining period character with modern living, moments from Angel.
Set above one of Islington’s most vibrant streets, this light-filled flat has been refurbished to a high standard throughout. It has warm oak-effect flooring, crisp white walls and a layout of separate rooms that gives it a real sense of space.
The reception room is the heart of the home and a real showpiece. It is generously proportioned and well lit by two tall sash windows. It keeps its original character, with a cast iron arched fireplace set within a marble surround, an ornate ceiling rose and detailed cornicing. The separate kitchen is bright and stylish. It is finished in glossy grey cabinetry with white stone-effect worktops and a striking blue-green brick-tile splashback. The double bedroom is a calm, airy retreat. It comes with a large three-door wardrobe with a full-length mirror, a bedside chest and a blackout blind, and it shares the same elegant cornicing as the rest of the flat.
The contemporary shower room is fully tiled in soft grey stone-effect tiles. It has a curved glass shower enclosure with a rainfall shower head, a sleek vanity basin, a mirror cabinet, a heated towel rail and recessed lighting.
Location: You’re right in the heart of Angel. The famous Chapel Market is on your doorstep, offering fresh produce, street food, cafés and restaurants. Upper Street’s bars, shops and theatres are a short stroll away, and Angel Underground station (Northern line) is just minutes on foot.  Description
 Set on the sixth floor of Carriage House, this bright apartment offers a well-connected Finsbury Park base, with a private balcony, floor-to-ceiling glazing and the convenience of a 24-hour concierge. Gail’s, M&S Food and Gymbox are on site, while Finsbury Park Station is moments away for easy journeys across London.
 The open-plan reception and kitchen extends over 25ft, with full-height glazed doors opening onto the balcony. Wide-plank flooring, recessed downlights and warm terracotta feature walls give the space a welcoming feel. Underfloor heating runs throughout, and there is room for both a dining table and a comfortable seating area. The balcony, finished with composite decking and a glass balustrade, looks over the landscaped gardens below.
 The kitchen has high-gloss, handleless cabinetry, pale worktops and a smoky grey glass splashback. Integrated Bosch appliances include an oven and hob, with a concealed extractor above, alongside a stainless steel sink with a swan-neck mixer.
 A slate-blue hallway with video entry leads to the bedroom and bathroom. The double bedroom has a full-height window overlooking greenery towards the park, mirrored sliding wardrobes and soft grey carpeting. The bathroom is finished with stone-effect porcelain tiles and dark wood-effect panelling, with a full-size bath, overhead rainfall shower, separate handheld shower, wall-hung WC and floating vanity with vessel basin.
 Carriage House forms part of City North, a contemporary development by Benson & Forsyth and Rolfe Judd. Residents have access to The Pavilion, a landscaped roof garden with lawns, ornamental grasses, decked walkways and a glass lounge beneath a planted roof.
 The neighbourhood: Finsbury Park 
 Finsbury Park Station is close by, with Piccadilly, Victoria and Great Northern/Thameslink services connecting the area with King’s Cross, the City and the West End. Finsbury Park itself is a short walk away, with a boating lake, tennis courts, a Saturday morning park run and seasonal events.
 There are plenty of nearby places for coffee, food and evenings out. Bon Matin on Wells Terrace serves baguettes, pastries and cakes, while Common Ground on Stroud Green Road pairs Dark Arts coffee with sandwiches and a garden. Blighty on Blackstock Road is known for its full English breakfast. The Faltering Fullback offers a leafy beer garden, and the Finsbury Park Picturehouse is within walking distance.

 Features and description
 One bedroom with mirrored wardrobes and leafy views
 Open-plan reception and kitchen opening onto a private balcony
 Sleek handleless kitchen with integrated Bosch appliances
 Landscaped residents’ roof garden
 On-site concierge plus M&S, Gail’s and Gymbox
 Fully Furnished
 Available Immedietly
 0.1 miles to Finsbury Park Station
 Set on the sixth floor of Carriage House, this bright apartment offers a well-connected Finsbury Park base, with a private balcony, floor-to-ceiling glazing and the convenience of a 24-hour concierge. Gail’s, M&S Food and Gymbox are on site, while Finsbury Park Station is moments away for easy journeys across London.
 The open-plan reception and kitchen extends over 25ft, with full-height glazed doors opening onto the balcony. Wide-plank flooring, recessed downlights and warm terracotta feature walls give the space a welcoming feel. Underfloor heating runs throughout, and there is room for both a dining table and a comfortable seating area. The balcony, finished with composite decking and a glass balustrade, looks over the landscaped gardens below.
 The kitchen has high-gloss, handleless cabinetry, pale worktops and a smoky grey glass splashback. Integrated Bosch appliances include an oven and hob, with a concealed extractor above, alongside a stainless steel sink with a swan-neck mixer.
 A slate-blue hallway with video entry leads to the bedroom and bathroom. The double bedroom has a full-height window overlooking greenery towards the park, mirrored sliding wardrobes and soft grey carpeting. The bathroom is finished with stone-effect porcelain tiles and dark wood-effect panelling, with a full-size bath, overhead rainfall shower, separate handheld shower, wall-hung WC and floating vanity with vessel basin.
 Carriage House forms part of City North, a contemporary development by Benson & Forsyth and Rolfe Judd. Residents have access to The Pavilion, a landscaped roof garden with lawns, ornamental grasses, decked walkways and a glass lounge beneath a planted roof.
 The neighbourhood: Finsbury Park 
 Finsbury Park Station is close by, with Piccadilly, Victoria and Great Northern/Thameslink services connecting the area with King’s Cross, the City and the West End. Finsbury Park itself is a short walk away, with a boating lake, tennis courts, a Saturday morning park run and seasonal events.
 There are plenty of nearby places for coffee, food and evenings out. Bon Matin on Wells Terrace serves baguettes, pastries and cakes, while Common Ground on Stroud Green Road pairs Dark Arts coffee with sandwiches and a garden. Blighty on Blackstock Road is known for its full English breakfast. The Faltering Fullback offers a leafy beer garden, and the Finsbury Park Picturehouse is within walking distance.

 The Property 
 A one bedroom, first floor flat in a new build property is available to rent from Dec 29th for 4 months (until April 29th) (all bills included except cleaning fee £60 a week (optional)).
 The property is located on a quiet, no exit residential street and just one minute walk away from the buzzing Kingsland Road in Dalston.
The property makes for the perfect home for a couple. One double bedroom with wardrobe, chest of drawers and queen size bed with a brand new mattress is East facing so gets the morning sun. (2 full sets of beddings are provided) 
 There is a big bathroom with juliette doors, bathtub and shower, bidet and storage. (2 full sets of towels are provided)
 The spacious open plan kitchen / dinning area / front room makes this the heart of the flat. The kitchen benefits from ample storage and cupboard space, fridge, freezer, microwave, oven, eletric cooktop, washing machine and dishwasher, and complete appliances available to use.
There is a large hallway that has a great working desk with screen and printer available. The internet is very speed 500mega up and down.
The balcony is West facing perfect for sunsets.
 Modern touches like triple glazing and digitally controled heating throughout, make this flat super cozy, warm and silent. 
 There's a large communal garden and there is also room for bike storage if needed.
 The second bedroom is closed off and the property is being rented with just one bedroom. If you would like that to be available please send us a message to discuss.

 One double bedroom
 One bathroom
 Ample hallway with deskspace
 Open space Kitchen / Front Room
 Balcony
 Communal Garden 
 Furnished

 Fibre Optic Broadband

 8 minute walk to Dalston Kinglsand Overground Station

 Organic/bio shops open every day (Harvest is a  fave)
 Ridley Road Market every Mon-Sat

 M&S, Sainsbury's, Tescos, Amazon Fresh
 10min walk from Anytime fitness gym and many yoga studios

 Close to Newignton Green, Clissold Park and London Fields
 Buses that easily connect to Broadway Market, Stoke Newignton, Shoreditch, etc.
 20min bus to Liverpool Street
 12min overground to Stratford
 25min overground + victoria line to Oxford Circus
 PS: This is our beloved home we’re renting while away abroad to stay with family.
